question: Can the one demonstrated Frozen-KV MTP spec-v2 overlap mechanism plausibly make the immutable c32 workload reach 0.6381105231 seconds per request?

speculative/spec_info.py.binding: lines 148-149 exclude Frozen-KV MTP from supports_spec_v2; lines 179-190 reject overlap and select FrozenKVMTPWorker

managers/scheduler.py.binding: line 331 derives enable_overlap from the forced flag; lines 1421-1437 run and process each batch serially; lines 3025-3035 show that mid-worker on_publish is reserved for spec v2

speculative/frozen_kv_mtp_worker.py.binding: lines 432-476 execute draft, target verify, and next-seed selection in strict order before returning to the scheduler

single_mechanism_reference.name: upstream_frozen_kv_mtp_spec_v2
single_mechanism_reference.binding: FrozenKVMTPWorkerV2 uses the EAGLE v2 scheduler contract; lines 760-766 still execute draft then target verify and publish only after verify, before seed selection/draft-extend
single_mechanism_reference.predicted_counter_movement: enable the overlap event loop and move result publication to the verify-end fence, hiding scheduler/result CPU work behind seed selection and the following forward; target-verify count, two-token verify geometry, assistant path, cache policy, target-only fused QKV dispatch, and stock KV-shared assistant QKV remain unchanged

measured_trace.token_conservation: 32 first tokens + 6544 verify bonus tokens + 4880 accepted drafts = 11456 completion tokens

oracle.source_bound_reason: The demonstrated V2 mechanism publishes after target verify and does not change target-verify geometry. The measured target-verify span alone exceeds the entire c32 ceiling by 5.5574090088 seconds. Even granting perfect overlap of every other measured second and all assistant work cannot reach the gate. The unchanged geometry also evaluates 14.5658% more target decode positions than stock because tail acceptance collapses.

decision.result: Close the overlap-only Frozen-KV MTP line under the immutable proposal geometry and workload. A future reopening requires a separately admitted mechanism that changes target-verify work or proposal economics, which this contract forbids.
